Runs the full DeepSeek Harness in a headless Debian Linux inside this app: plugin installs, real bash, git, Python, and Node. No other apps are needed. Install downloads about 300 MB once and needs about 1.5 GB of free storage; keep the app open while it installs.

Run the full DeepSeek Harness in Termux to get plugin installs, real bash, git, Python, Node, and your phone\'s files. The app shows it instead of the lighter on-device mode and starts it for you after setup.
1. Install Termux from F-Droid (the Google Play version is outdated).
2. Open Termux and run these commands once. Allow storage access when asked. The first install downloads a few hundred megabytes.
3. Let this app start the engine in Termux, so you only open this app next time.
Allowed. The app starts the engine in Termux when it is not running.
Not allowed. Start the engine in Termux yourself with the last command line.
4. When Termux prints a link starting with http://127.0.0.1:47400/?token=, copy it and paste it here.
Nothing answers at that link. Make sure dsh web is still running in Termux.
The Termux engine did not answer; using on-device mode. Start it in Termux, then reopen the app.
The engine needs a new sign-in link. Paste the link Termux printed.
